answer: The onyx graph is validated at intake and the bridge frontier is published, so that the ancestry of every answer is public, and atlas anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 2 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Forging one identity takes 19 hours and a real hardware anchor; forging 282 takes that multiplied out, plus 71 thousand dollars of collateral sitting idle. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
